; Keystone  (22 words, cc=2, 39 free)
capabilities {
    Tunnel E
}

IADD  DR12, DR0, DR0
MCMP  DR1, DR12
BRANCHNE  +4
IADD  DR12, DR0, DR0
IADD  DR1, DR12, DR0
RETURN
SHR  DR12, DR1, 28
IADD  DR4, DR12, DR0
IADD  DR12, DR0, #1
MCMP  DR4, DR12
BRANCHEQ  +4
IADD  DR12, DR0, DR0
IADD  DR1, DR12, DR0
RETURN
IADD  DR12, DR0, #1
IADD  DR1, DR12, DR0
RETURN
LOAD  CR0, CR6]
CALL  CR0
IADD  DR4, DR1, DR0
IADD  DR1, DR4, DR0
RETURN
description: Boot3 — the boot trampoline lump (token 00000600, NS slot 6) executed by the hardware ROM during boot phases B:01–B:07.  Loads NS, Thread, and Boot3 lumps, then CALL CR0 (Thread.CR[0]) enters the configured first abstraction directly.
